title: Research Harness Finding (MIF-backed)
description: A research finding is a MIF v1.0 memory unit (schemas/mif/mif.schema.json) extended with two harness-local concerns that MIF core does not carry (SPEC §8b): a non-empty citation set (citation-integrity is a core gate, SPEC §6c/§6d) and an adversarial-falsification verification record under extensions.harness. The base $ref points at the REAL vendored MIF schema; this file only adds, never overrides. Also enforces the canonical mif-spec.dev Level 2/3 floor (modified, temporal, temporal.validFrom) that the base schema leaves optional (research-harness-template#480) — every finding and rendered report gates through this file (write-finding.sh, mif-project.sh), so requiring these here is what makes the harness's own MIF Level 3 claim actually true against the canonical schema, not just its own bespoke reading of it.

citations.description: MIF Level 3 citations; at least one is required so every finding is traceable to a primary source (citation-integrity gate).

temporal.description: Canonical MIF Level 3 requires temporal.validFrom in addition to temporal being present (Level 2). The shape of temporal itself (validFrom/validUntil/recordedAt/ttl/decay) is governed by the base schema's TemporalMetadata definition; this only adds the validFrom requirement.

dimension.description: The config-declared research dimension this finding belongs to (domain-general; not a fixed market-research set). SPEC §4a.

verification.description: Harness-local falsification trait (SPEC §8b): the ordinal verdict from the single adversarial gate.

gathered_under.description: Provenance (SPEC §11): the single goal version whose research first produced this finding, stamped by the orchestrator when the finding lands. Immutable; distinct from membership. Membership (which versions a finding is in scope for) is NOT a finding field — it is the re-derivable projection goal_versions[]/stale_in[] on the research-index, authored from the per-version goals/goal-<hash>.members.json files by build-index.sh.
